description.en: A settings page that builds and manages dsh agent modes. Each mode starts from an official composition (standard, PTC, minimal or Cordis) and can be adjusted row by row: the plugin rows a mode mounts are switched individually, rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, and the mode can be renamed. The mode's system prompt is a plain file that the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step. Several modes are managed from the same page, each with its own prompt.
description.zh: 在设置页里构建并管理 dsh 模式：每个模式以官方组成（standard、PTC、极简或 Cordis）为底子，并可逐行调整——逐行开关该模式挂载哪些插件，未触碰的行与出厂行逐字节相同，模式名可改。模式的系统提示词是普通文件，agent 循环会在每次模型调用前重新读取，因此改动对正在运行的会话下一步生效。同一个页面可管理多个模式，各自的提示词互相独立。
